description: Install test dependencies (pytest-cov) and verify baseline test infrastructure works
steps: Run: pip install pytest-cov in the MediaCrawler directory
Verify existing tests pass: pytest tests/ -v --timeout=30
Verify config module imports properly: python -c 'import config'
acceptance_criteria: Existing tests pass (or at least the test framework works)
verification: Run: pip install pytest-cov && pytest tests/test_store_factory.py -v
findings: pytest-cov 7.1.0 installed. 8/9 existing tests pass. test_create_excel_store has a pre-existing failure (ExcelStoreBase vs XhsExcelStoreImplement type mismatch). Config module imports successfully with ENABLE_STEALTH_BROWSER and STEALTH_HUMANIZE attributes available. pytest-asyncio 1.4.0 already installed.
